notes.title: Hotfix #1 — Movement Speed Change, Bugfixes
notes.content:
Base movement speed for the player has been increased

Fixed an issue, that caused temporary slowdowns from specific interactions to never reset, making it impossible to complete certain puzzles

notes.title: Steam milestone!
notes.content:
We’ve recently hit an amazing milestone! Eclipsium is now officially among the Top 1000 Most Wishlisted Games on Steam! 

This is more than just a number, it’s a testament to the passion, hard work, and creativity our team has poured into bringing this game to life.

To every single person who's clicked that wishlist button : Thank you! Without your support we wouldn't be able to do this and your support means everything to us. 

If you want to see more about development, sneak peaks at potential features and more then you should check out our socials linked below. Also make sure to join our discord community to chat with the devs and other people excited about Eclipsium!

notes.title: Eclipsium has been nominated for PC Gamer's "Most Wanted" Game Show!
notes.content:
Nomination
Eclipsium has been nominated alongside 99 other games for PCGamers "Most Wanted" Game Show!
A huge thank you to PCGamer for nominating Eclipsium to the show! It's a tremendous honor to be mentioned in the same breath as these incredible  games.

The live show will take place at 8 PM GMT on December 5th and will be hosted on PC Gamer's various channels. Fingers crossed that Eclipsium makes it into the top 25!

Learn More

Reminder
We’d like to take this opportunity to remind everyone to play and review the Eclipsium demo if you haven’t already! It means a lot to us and helps us reach a wider audience. If you encounter any bugs or want to leave feedback, please share it in our community Discord channel. (Or just come hang out and ask us questions!)

Lastly, don’t forget to wishlist the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2419670/Eclipsium/

notes.title: New Demo page - Live Now!
notes.content:
Ayo!

Steam recently updated how demos can be displayed, giving more power and options to us, the developers. We won't cover all the details, but the important part is that there's now a new page for the Eclipsium demo!

What will change?

 You can now leave a review on the demo!
 It's easier to manage the demo in your Steam library
The demo page can appear in more places on Steam

Why are you telling me this?
Mostly because we would greatly appreciate each and every one of you leaving a review on the demo. We read and value all the feedback we receive, so the more the merrier. It also helps us grow and reach more people through Steam. 

Is the demo updated?
Right now our number one priority is to work on the final version of the game rather than updating the demo. This means that all the content in the demo is the same as before (other than minor bug fixes).

If you still have any questions, don't hesitate to ask us.

So what are you waiting for? Go play the demo if you haven't already, and please leave us a review!

///Housefire

notes.title: Exciting News!
notes.content:
Ayo!

Only been a couple of weeks this time since we last spoke even though it feels like yesterday. Time flies! 

Let's start of with : Wishlists!
Eclipsium recently surpassed over 11.000 wishlists! To say we never imagined we'd get this far would be an understatement. We want to thank each and everyone of you who've shown support to this passion project, truly. With this comes a feeling of great responsibility, we're working harder than ever to make sure the game lives up to your expectations. 

Can't forget : Events!
You might have noticed Eclipsium popping up in a few different places on the web. That's because we had the pleasure of being part of: 

Games to Get Excited About Fest 2024 hosted by Alpha Beta Gamer  

Indie FPS summer showcase hosted by ZlimBratSki. 

These were both amazing events that showcased the mind-blowing creativity and passion of the current indie game landscape. We're super proud to be shown next to these amazing games and a huge thank you to Alpha Beta Gamer and ZlimBratSki! Make sure to check out their channels and content.  

Last but not least : Playtesting!
As we're expanding the game and adding new content, we'll run regular playtests to make sure everything's up to par in terms of clarity and quality. While we can't share the details quite yet on when we will start hosting playtests, we can with certainty say where. our Discord server! 

If YOU want to be part of improving Eclipsium by playtesting it and giving us valuable feedback, make sure to join our Discord server to stay up to date once we announce the start of playtesting! 

As always, Discord and Twitter are the best places to follow along the development. Until next time! 

Discord : Link
Twitter / X : Link

//Housefire

notes.title: Eclipsium - Quick Devpost!
notes.content:
Ayo!
Last time we shared a devpost was a couple of months ago and a lot has happended since then so we thought we'd give you all a quick update.

- Development
We've been hard at work planning, refining and creating content for the game. We're super excited about what we have in the works and we can't wait for you all to experience it.  Here's a quick sneak peak of one of the new areas we've added to the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091159/7a8d74fd590dbf19f9f837d2dba8367260bd42ed.gif
- Graduation
Last week Eclipsium graduated! Well, all developers working on the game did. Eclipsium originally started off as a student project which we then decided to keep working on during our studies. Having now graduated, we're happy to say that the entire team is committed to continue development full-time! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091159/04cc8df7166338651032c560ed6d95e6104ada5a.png
- Thank you
Lastly we want to give a huuuuuge thank you to everyone who has supported the game up to this point and beyond. We wouldn't be here doing this if it wasn't for you and we couldn't be happier ːluvː

For more sneak peaks into the development of Eclipsium go follow us on Twitter and join our discord server!

notes.title: Eclipsium - Next Fest Thanks and Upcoming!
notes.content:
Ayo! 

Steam Next Fest has wrapped up and we're amazed at the reponse we've gotten! We want to start off by thanking each and every one who played the demo, left us feedback or engaged with the game. We're happy to announce that thanks to your support, we've now surpassed 4000 wishlists for the game!
This is a huge milestone for us and we couldn't be more grateful.

What's next? 

We're currently hard at work expanding all areas of the game, such as the inside of the tower. We have a ton of cool ideas and we can't wait to show them off to you in the full release! While we've got your attention we'll take this moment to also mention that we have a Discord server and Twitter account where we post behind-the-scene stuff and more! To stay up to date make sure to check them both out below.
